## Problem / motivation

## Scope / contract notes
NetPlanner is advisory-only software with a defined build contract
(`docs/PID.md`). If this touches the agents, TCO math, or pricing logic, note how
it preserves that contract (and whether it would need a PID amendment).

Anything else — mockups, examples, links.
